problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y=\frac{5}{x}?$
worked_solution:
To plot $y=\frac{5}{x},$ we apply the following steps:

- Take the curve $y=\frac{1}{x}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/b3a79a8dbe82342c0ab1e16371f8c1d82833f4ebc3bad659f1a619ab1e92733e.png)

- Stretch the result by a scale factor of $5$ parallel to the $y$-axis to get the graph of $y=\frac{5}{x}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/eeb158823a32a215dcf72d67bd27b8ad5df238ee44af535afd5850a15f9d17c0.png)
